summary: Implemented the rich.progress open and wrap_file feature. Changes are additive and limited to the in-scope files: rich/progress.py (module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, private _FileReader class and _reader_context helper), tests/test_progress.py (22 new tests inserted before the __main__ block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage), and CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet linking PR 1759). Diff is 814 insertions and 0 deletions. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, black, and a Python 3.6 import check were not run, because the task forbade running repository code; all verification was by reading. Choices to review: the context wrapper is a contextmanager generator; text mode exits the underlying binary reader via value.buffer; mode and name delegating properties were added so the reader can be instantiated on Python 3.6; only the suppressions the spec names for readinto, readline, and the handle's readinto call were added, and the module-level open return-value/type-var suppression was not added, which is unverified until mypy runs.
